== Description ==

Group photograph of attendees with lightsabers at the [[2025 World Championship]]. Faces are numbered left to right across the photograph (standing and kneeling together); kneeling players are marked. 42 people are named and 12 are unknown.

* 1. [[Greg Shaw]]: standing far left; red Phillies "Take October" hoodie; name tag "Greg".
* 2. [[Chris Schoenthal]]: behind Greg Shaw; black SWCCG cap, glasses, long beard, black polo embroidered "Chris Schoenthal / Advocate".
* 3. [[Barry Alperstein]]: green Middle-earth Mordor T-shirt.
* 4. [[Mike Kessling]]: blue New Allies T-shirt; name tag "Mike".
* 5. [[Jarad Konsker]]: behind Mike Kessling; dark cap, glasses, goatee.
* 6. [[Brian Fred]]: behind Mike Kessling; bald, glasses, grey beard.
* 7. [[Mark Billings]]: patterned cardigan over a Boba Fett T-shirt; ponytail, glasses.
* 8. [[Nick Swedal]]: behind Mark Billings; short dark hair, grey quarter-zip collar.
* 9. [[Erik Spijksma]]: black graphic T-shirt, glasses, name tag; behind Chris Wirfs.
* 10. [[Chris Wirfs]]: kneeling front row; floral shirt; name tag "WIRFS".
* 11. [[Joe Phillips]]: grey cap with a round logo, white T-shirt.
* 12. [[Justin Miyashiro]]: glasses, goatee, black T-shirt.
* 13. [[Mike French]]: grey zip hoodie, glasses.
* 14. [[Anthony Howard]]: kneeling front row; blue hoodie, Dodgers cap.
* 15. [[Sam Tashima]]: grey Nike polo, glasses.
* (no number) [[Garrett Larson]]: back, directly behind Sam Tashima; pink cap (face hidden).
* 16. Unknown: back, behind Garrett Larson; glasses, moustache, dark clothing.
* 17. [[Steve Harpster]]: back centre; white hair, glasses, grey beard.
* 18. [[AJ Hatoum]]: black lightsaber-graphic T-shirt, glasses; name tag "AJ".
* 19. [[Scott Lingrell]]: kneeling front row; navy Philadelphia Union jersey.
* 20. Unknown: back; dark swept-back hair, handlebar moustache, dark shirt.
* 21. [[Amar Banger]]: back; bald, full dark beard.
* 22. Unknown: back; dark wavy hair, round face, smiling.
* 23. [[Charlie Arlandson]]: back; bald, light stubble, smiling.
* 24. [[Brandon Baity]]: grey-green jacket, name tag, green lightsaber.
* 25. [[Karl Koenig]]: back; red jacket over a yellow T-shirt.
* 26. [[Jeff Lavigne]]: kneeling front row; maroon T-shirt.
* 27. [[Logan Pietig]]: back; young, wavy light-brown hair, dark UNL hoodie.
* 28. [[Matt Thornton]]: tan cap with a patch, full beard, black hoodie.
* 29. [[Randy Scott]]: black Colorado Avalanche cap, glasses, beard, Tatooine T-shirt.
* 30. Unknown: back; glasses, short grey-brown hair, light grey shirt, smiling.
* 31. [[Nathan Russell]]: glasses, receding hair, black Star Wars T-shirt with red lettering.
* 32. Unknown: back; dark hair, full greying beard, smiling.
* 33. [[Robbie Hendon]]: kneeling front row; grey SWCCG Players Committee cap, grey T-shirt, goatee.
* 34. Unknown: back; glasses, partly hidden.
* 35. [[Joe Olson]]: grey T-shirt, glasses, reddish beard, name tag "Joe", lightsaber.
* 36. Unknown: back, behind Joe Olson; cap, partly hidden.
* 37. [[Phil Aasen]]: grey flat cap, beard, black jacket.
* 38. Unknown: back; blue cap (face hidden).
* 39. [[Bill Kafer]]: teal cap, glasses, beard, black polo embroidered "Bill Kafer / Streaming Team".
* 40. [[Casey Anis]]: kneeling front row; grey jacket.
* 41. Unknown: back; black cap with sunglasses on the brim, smiling.
* 42. Unknown: back; dark cap, partly hidden.
* 43. [[Ming Huo]]: grey T-shirt, name tag, lightsaber.
* 44. Unknown: back; light tan cap, smiling.
* 45. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]: back right; beard, blue shirt.
* 46. [[Jordan Gosiaco]]: kneeling front row; curly hair, brown shirt.
* 47. Unknown: short light hair, glasses, black zip hoodie over a graphic T-shirt, name tag.
* 48. [[Spencer Gosiaco]]: black Mariners "S" cap.
* 49. [[Kyle Kallin]]: black Sonics cap, glasses, beard, grey T-shirt.
* 50. [[Taylor Gosiaco]]: kneeling front row; navy shirt, glasses.
* 51. [[Ryan French]]: bald, glasses, goatee, Boba Fett armour zip hoodie.
* 52. [[Daniel Amor]]: sage green hoodie with a white line-art graphic, glasses, name tag, lightsaber.

Also matched from named 2025 photographs and [[Logan Pietig]]'s UNL hoodie: [[Amar Banger]] (#21), [[Charlie Arlandson]] (#23), [[Logan Pietig]] (#27), and [[Ryan French]] (#51). Unknown faces and the participants still to place are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]].
